about: huggingface's decision table (the P3 procedure). The Hub's repositories are git with LFS objects; a pinned revision is a real commit, so a World is seeded by creating the repository (the API) and pushing the real one (git smart HTTP and git-lfs's batch API, the kernel's git library, served as screens at the Hub's own paths). Downloads are resolve (a redirect: a regular file to the resolve cache, an LFS object to the CDN) and the bytes with Range. Every other operation is unmodeled.

decisions.demand: the seeding rule (stored data through the vendor's own API): the repository localrouter downloads from exists before it is pushed to; the life's chapter 2
decisions.why: an action: a model repository under the token's user or a named organization, its git repository empty; 409 when it exists

decisions.demand: localrouter's cache, Node and browser (cache/node.mjs:633, cache/web.mjs:657)
decisions.why: a computed read of the repository's git: the revision (a branch or a commit), the file at its path; a regular file redirected to the resolve cache, an LFS pointer to the CDN, with the Hub's x-repo-commit and linked headers; the Hub's 401 and 404s

decisions.demand: localrouter's cache, after resolve's redirect (cache/node.mjs:633, cache/web.mjs:657)
decisions.why: a computed read: a regular file's bytes at a commit, with its git sha as ETag, Range and If-Range

decisions.demand: the seeding rule: pushing needs a user's token
decisions.why: a Hugging Face account and its access token are made on the Hub's pages

decisions.demand: The platform refresh scope reads the repository known to its root; src/manifest.ts, ModelInfo.refresh.
decisions.why: The Hub documents reading model information by namespace/name. Store namespace and repo at creation for the known read’s two path parameters; ModelInfo _id preserves its creation ObjectId while id names namespace/name; its author is stored and read as the vendor documents.
